verdict.rationale: Drata's Public APIv2 covers a wide swath of core UI functionality — Personnel, Devices, Controls, Risks, Policies, Audits, Monitoring Tests, and Custom Connections — suggesting broad but not confirmed full parity with the UI (e.g., Trust Center, Risk Assessment, Policy Center are documented as UI features without matching API endpoint citations in the pack). Probes also show no discoverable openapi.json/spec, limiting programmatic/AI-native verification of full coverage. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of 1:1 feature parity (e.g., Trust Center configuration, Policy Center authoring workflows via API), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent/hands-on corroboration that API coverage matches UI capabilities completely.
